description: Machine-readable manifest of the canonical translation stack. Generated in part from schemas/*.py (layers, required fields); hand-maintained parts are precedence, gates, and site mapping. check.py verifies this file stays in sync with the code.
invariants: L0.chosen == T1.quick_gloss unless L0.revised with reason
fork live|resolved requires >=2 options; resolved requires argmap option_choices entry with matching chosen_index
argmap traces resolve: t1_verse exists, every l0_id exists, sanskrit_sha matches source
L2 lists >=1 existing l0_id per verse
non-standard C1 renders map every paragraph to essence indices
coverage: T1+L0+argmap+L2 span exactly the GRETIL verse set

site_mapping.layers_json: built by site/build.py build_layers() — do not hand-write
site_mapping.rule: BLOCKED chunks never show English; missing works render greyed, never invented
